VISUAL CONTINUITY BIBLE:

This film belongs to the same continuous cinematic universe.

The digital office is the Mokaid AI Office shown in the reference image:
a premium stylized 3D office environment, slightly isometric but fully volumetric,
dark charcoal architecture, sophisticated violet and electric blue neon floor lighting,
warm amber practical lights, elegant desks, screens, plants, meeting room, coffee area,
lounge area and foosball table.

Keep the exact same architecture, furniture language, lighting palette and spatial identity
throughout every shot.

The AI employees are friendly premium stylized humanoid digital workers.
They are not metallic robots and not cartoon characters.
They look intelligent, approachable, professional and slightly futuristic.
Consistent character design throughout the film.

Cinematic physically plausible camera movement.
Premium global illumination.
Soft volumetric light.
Realistic depth of field.
Subtle motion blur.
High-end commercial cinematography.
No chaotic camera movement.
No sudden geometry changes.
No morphing furniture.
No disappearing characters.
No duplicated characters.
No warped screens.
No text generated inside screens unless specifically requested.

Every shot must feel like the camera is physically travelling through one continuous place.
Smooth acceleration and deceleration.
Elegant ease-in and ease-out camera curves.
No hard cuts unless explicitly requested.

CAMERA MOTION LANGUAGE:
The camera movement must feel designed for interactive website scrollytelling.
Every major movement follows cinematic easing curves:
stillness → gradual acceleration → fluid travel → gradual deceleration → stillness.
No constant-speed robotic camera movement.
Create natural visual resting points where the website can pause the video during scrolling.
Use strong foreground parallax when travelling through the office.
Occasionally pass close to desks, plants, chairs and characters to reinforce depth and immersion.
Movement should feel like a premium interactive experience,
somewhere between an Apple product film, a Pixar environment exploration
and a high-end architectural camera tour.
No shaky camera. No handheld movement. No whip pans. No random zooms. No hard transitions.


SCENE 6 — LIFE IN THE OFFICE, PORTRAIT CONTINUITY SHOT.
Start at the EXACT supplied start image: camera just outside blue illuminated glass meeting room, looking at the auburn-haired woman in sage blouse seated at the graphite table and the standing man in violet overshirt, shared tablet. Keep their faces, clothing, furniture, blue door frame and real spatial positions. They remain solid and continuous. Camera is INSIDE one full-size office.

One single physical camera travelling shot, no edit, no dissolve, no metamorphosis. For the first second gently decelerate the existing forward move. Then glide LEFTWARD out through the already open meeting-room entrance, revealing the existing warm amber coffee counter in the back-center of this SAME office, not a new location. The auburn/sage woman naturally stands and moves toward the coffee counter alongside the camera, never teleporting. Around seconds 3-7, a close medium portrait of her hands operating the espresso machine and rich dark espresso flowing into one white ceramic cup, warm steam lit by amber practicals, then she gently lifts the cup. A calm, personable and productive pause.

The camera continues physically sliding out along the violet illuminated floor aisle toward the existing graphite foosball table at front/right. Around seconds 8-12 settle into the exact end-image camera position at one SHORT END of the table, looking lengthwise down its diagonal depth. Show the violet-overshirt man and brown-skinned curly-haired man in amber sweater naturally playing opposite sides. The violet man arrives by walking along the adjacent clear aisle; do not duplicate him in the meeting room. Both full faces, both pairs of hands holding straight rods and the ball on the playing field stay visible inside central 75 percent of tall image. One small goal and restrained amused reaction, no exaggerated comedy. End in the supplied foosball portrait composition with smooth deceleration.

Preserve master charcoal architecture, meeting room at rear/right and coffee counter at rear/left, actual plants, same desks. Reference final frame defines a different physical camera position in same place, NOT furniture changing. Keep top 20 percent dark architecture clear for later editorial title, but render NO text, NO words, NO logos, NO floating graphics. Friendly sophisticated adults, same premium semi-realistic stylized 3D humans, not metallic robots, normal anatomy. No hard cuts, no zooms, no dissolving walls, no portals, no laptop.

SOUND: subdued office room tone and distant keyboard typing throughout; natural espresso machine and coffee pour in middle, ceramic cup gently touching counter, then small foosball ball and rods impacts. Very quiet unvoiced conversational murmur only, no intelligible dialogue, no voiceover and no loud music. Natural warm calm soundscape.
